subject: Coffee & Tea
title: What Is Fair Trade Coffee?
description: Learn What Is Fair Trade Coffee? in one minute.

hook.text: Fair Trade certification promises farmers a minimum price floor—no matter how low the market drops.

buildup.text: The Fair Trade minimum for Arabica is $1.40/lb. If the market is higher, farmers get market price plus a premium.

discovery.text: The premium ($0.20/lb) goes to a community fund for schools, clean water, or infrastructure improvements.

twist.text: Critics say Fair Trade's floor price is still too low to cover costs once certification fees and compliance are factored in.

climax.text: Fair Trade represents only 5–8% of global coffee. Most farmers never access the program.

punchline.text: A floor, a premium, a start. But not yet a full solution.

quiz.question: What is the Fair Trade minimum price for Arabica coffee?
